description: Adapter-level (shared-LoRA) continual learning: 4-task Standard CL stream, one persistent LoRA adapter, released AIMMerging schedule.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: HF linear with 50 warmup updates (first update lr 0), fresh optimizer + scheduler per stage

precision: frozen fp32 base, fp32 adapter weights, bf16 autocast, TF32 off
merge_events: p = 0.25 at T = 310: updates 78, 156, 234, 310 (K = 4); SFA per-merge beta = 1 - (1 - beta_end)^(1/4)

coefficient_selection_rule.reference: A_ref = development acquisition (mean over stages of the current-task accuracy right after its stage) of sequential LoRA, seed 17
coefficient_selection_rule.rule: for each method and requirement: among candidates with development acquisition >= A_ref - tolerance, choose the highest development earlier-task accuracy (mean final accuracy on tasks 1-3); ties within 0.002 -> coefficient 0.5, then the larger coefficient; none feasible -> infeasible. Selected configurations are replicated unchanged on seeds 42 and 123 before any test evaluation.
